page_title: Unsora: Make Content, Clip Videos and Schedule Posts with AI

sources.entry: Unsora - Generates AI images, video, music and voiceovers and schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn and other connected accounts. #paid #opensource

summary.name: Unsora
summary.one_liner: Unsora is a paid creative toolkit that connects to AI agents like ChatGPT and Claude so they can generate video and images, clip long videos, upscale media, and schedule posts to social platforms.
use_cases: generate short-form video ads from a text prompt
clip a long webinar into captioned 9:16 shorts
schedule a week of posts across TikTok and Instagram
build a consistent AI presenter for videos
summary.what_it_does: Unsora is designed to be used through an AI agent: you connect it by pasting one MCP URL into ChatGPT, Claude, OpenClaw, Hermes or another MCP client, then ask for media in chat. It can generate video with Seedance 2.5, Kling 3, Veo 3.1 and Gemini Omni Flash, and images with Nano Banana, Seedream and GPT Image. It can find and clip moments from long videos, reframe them, and add animated captions. It also upscales images to 8K and video to 4K, and posts or schedules to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn. The same tools are available in a web app.
notable: Connects to AI agents via a single MCP URL with no install
Multiple video models on one credit balance
Clipping and captioning of long videos, with 35 caption styles
Agent confirms settings before spending credits; nothing posts without user action
caveats: Paid service; plans start at $19/month for 500 credits, with a 3-day free trial
Instagram posting needs a professional account
ChatGPT connector requires a paid ChatGPT plan
Frame-by-frame editing is not covered; the page points to a video editor for that
